title: Norfolk Southern celebrates 50 Trades on Track Scholarship recipients, investing in the next generation of skilled professionals
body_markdown:
Behind every train, rail line, and shipment are skilled professionals who keep America's freight network moving. From welders and electricians to diesel mechanics and equipment operators, their expertise helps power the railroad and the broader economy.


Now, Norfolk Southern is helping 50 aspiring skilled professionals take the next step in their careers through its 2026 Trades on Track Scholarship, awarding $250,000 to support technical education and training.


Launched in 2025 in partnership with SKILLED Nation, Trades on Track helps students and career changers overcome financial barriers to technical education, preparing them for skilled trades careers that support critical infrastructure and American industries. Each recipient will receive a $5,000 scholarship to help cover tuition, tools, equipment, and other education-related expenses.


**Top Takeaways**


- Building on early success: Now in its second year, Trades on Track has expanded from 20 scholarships in 2025 to 50 in 2026, reaching more aspiring skilled professionals.
- Supporting different career paths: The program helps students entering technical education, those continuing their training, and individuals looking to transition into skilled trades careers. ****


****


**Meet the 2026 scholarship recipients**


This year's recipients are pursuing certificates and degrees at technical schools and community colleges across the country.


Among this year's recipients:


- Aaron Arnold-Higgs | Ellenwood, Georgia, is pursuing electrical training at Lincoln Tech in East Point, Georgia.
- Jessica Greenlee | Portsmouth, Virginia, pursuing diesel technology training at Advanced Technology Institute in Virginia Beach.
- Shanice Bryson | Huntsville, Alabama, pursuing railroad welding studies at Drake State Community and Technical College.
- Zachary Brooks | Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania, is pursuing heavy equipment training at Pennsylvania College of Technology in Williamsport.

**What we're saying**


"Behind each scholarship recipient is a unique story, a personal ambition, and a commitment to building a future in the skilled trades. We're proud to recognize this year's recipients and support them as they turn their goals into careers. We can't wait to see what they accomplish." - Kristin Wong, Director, Norfolk Southern Foundation & Community Impact


**The big picture**


Skilled trades are essential to the infrastructure that connects businesses, communities, and markets. By investing in technical education, Norfolk Southern is helping more individuals pursue meaningful careers while strengthening the pipeline of skilled professionals who support the railroad and the broader economy.


Congratulations to the 2026 Trades on Track Scholarship recipients!


Learn more about Norfolk Southern's Trades on Track Scholarship[here](https://www.norfolksouthern.com/en/commitments/in-your-community/community-impact/ns-scholarship-programs) .
